contract.governing_equations: Two reversible channels with voltage-independent cycle affinity a=Delta_mu/kBT; p_dot=(a++b-)(1-p)-(a-+b+)p, C0 V_dot=-GV-nq p_dot. Cr=nq^2/(4kBT)[1-gamma tanh(a/4)], lambda=2k(1+exp(-a/2)), ReY=Gleak+Cr lambda omega^2/(lambda^2+omega^2). Local instability -Cr>C0+G/lambda.
assumptions: Supplied symmetric two-state mean-field chemistry and independent reservoir drive; real multistate reduction unvalidated.
q is conjugate to measured terminal voltage, not formal/Bader/gate charge.
Positive geometric/parasitic C0, passive load, electrically blocking separator; no inductor or imposed waveform.
Numerical high-coupling q=.30e,gamma3,n=1e18/m^2,T423K,Delta_mu12kBT,k50/s,C0~.02403F/m^2,Gload5S/m^2 and zero leakage are unmeasured hypotheses.
contract.conservation_and_thermodynamics: Local detailed balance retains voltage-independent chemical affinity. Pchem-Pload-Pleak-Tsigma=U_dot-T S_dot, sigma>=0; periodic averages close chemical input=load+leak+entropy. Linear instability is not a stable nonlinear cycle theorem.
contract.materials: No identified stable catalyst. Gas-accessible redox nanogap is an electrostatic target only; screening, tethers, packing, surface chemistry and low leakage unproved.
contract.units_and_tolerances: SI per geometric area: q C, n m^-2,C0 F/m^2,G S/m^2,lambda s^-1,V volts,p dimensionless,power W/m^2. Experimental tolerances/calibration UNKNOWN; source predictions conditional.
contract.input_acquisition: Independently measure blocking capacitance, dielectric/electrode losses, terminal charge/coverage and full complex kinetic susceptibility before autonomous test. Add kinetic modes if measured; do not fit one pole after oscillation.
contract.error_budget: De-embed phase/cable/passive artifacts; quantify chemical/thermal/instrument noise, drift, leakage, finite-site effects, uncertainty and nonlinear/hysteretic response. No uncertainty budget acquired.
contract.energy_balance: Baseline source1.81129=1.00142+.80986W/m^2 up to floating error.55.29% is reacted-chemical-free-energy conversion excluding heaters, gas preparation/circulation, feed utilization, contacts, fabrication and electronics; not net system efficiency.
contract.reliability: No operating lifetime. At assumed3nm gap,peak~.24V/nm is a requirement, not demonstrated dielectric reliability; chemistry drift, breakdown/leakage and surface degradation remain.
contract.resources: Proposed blocking catalytic coupon, impedance/calibration instruments, coverage-sensitive spectroscopy, steady feed/temperature control, calibrated passive loads/shunt capacitances and product/free-energy assay. Availability/cost UNKNOWN.

failures.attempt: Treat adsorbate charge pulse or negative imaginary capacitance as power generation
failures.failure_scope: Reversible charging may return inventory or dissipate. Required negative REAL admittance and sustained passive-load chemical power are unmeasured.

failures.attempt: Treat linear instability as a stable nonlinear cycle theorem
failures.failure_scope: -Cr>C0+G/lambda is local linear instability only; numerical cycles occur for selected assumed parameters. Hysteresis/coexisting cycles require separate tests.

failures.attempt: Claim high power from100fold rate rescaling
failures.failure_scope: Rate/load scaling simply changes time in equations; required elementary2.16e6/s bandwidth, reactant delivery, dielectric reliability and material chemistry unestablished.

failures.attempt: Interpret12.67V full-coverage swing as ordinary Pt prediction
failures.failure_scope: Earlier mathematically simulated choice rejected as a credible material interpretation; charge, capacitance, density and voltage cannot be independently chosen.

failures.attempt: Integrate narrow power spikes on a uniform output grid
failures.failure_scope: Initial grid missed entropy/power spikes; released12point Gaussian quadrature on adaptive intervals is essential. Floating consistency is not independent physical validation.

failures.attempt: Treat independent favorable q,gamma,k,C as a qualified chemical interface
failures.failure_scope: Joint Marcus/electrostatic constraints and missing material prevent importing hypothetical efficiency or bandwidth into a device prediction.
